entities.name: high-value-transaction
entities.description: Any single transaction exceeding $10,000 in value, requiring mandatory compliance review

entities.name: velocity-spike
entities.description: Three or more transactions from the same member within a 5-minute window

entities.name: cross-border-transfer
entities.description: Transaction where merchant country differs from member's home country

entities.name: dormant-account-reactivation
entities.description: First transaction on an account with no activity for 90+ days

learned_thresholds.rationale: Fraudulent transactions cluster between $8,500-$9,999 to avoid the $10k reporting threshold. Lowering the review trigger catches 23% more confirmed fraud.
Legitimate rapid purchases (e.g. gas + convenience store) typically complete within 5 minutes. Fraudulent velocity spikes cluster under 3 minutes.
Friday 14:00-18:00 flags have 3x false-positive rate. Boosting confidence threshold by 0.15 during this window reduces false positives without missing true fraud.

edge_cases.description: Legitimate high-frequency trading bot accounts generate 50+ transactions per minute, triggering velocity alerts on every batch
edge_cases.resolution: Exempt accounts tagged as 'automated-trading' from velocity checks; apply dedicated algo-trading policy instead

edge_cases.description: Travel notification not propagated: member filed travel notice but geo-mismatch still triggered due to 24h sync delay with upstream system
edge_cases.resolution: Buffer geo-mismatch alerts for accounts with active travel notices by 30 minutes; check upstream sync status before escalating

edge_cases.description: Subscription renewals from foreign SaaS providers appear as cross-border transactions, generating monthly false positives for the same merchants
edge_cases.resolution: Build recurring-merchant allowlist from 3+ consecutive identical transactions; suppress geo-alerts for allowlisted merchants

velocity_spike.definition: Three or more transactions from one account within a configurable time window (default 5 minutes)
velocity_spike.context: Internal term used by the fraud detection team; not used in member communications

dormant_reactivation.definition: First transaction on an account that has had zero activity for 90 or more consecutive days
dormant_reactivation.context: Triggers enhanced verification flow regardless of transaction amount

MCC.definition: Merchant Category Code -- ISO 18245 four-digit code classifying the type of goods or services a merchant provides
MCC.context: Used to classify transaction risk; MCC 5411 (grocery) is lowest risk, MCC 6051 (quasi-cash) is highest
